name: Timemore Sculptor 078S
details: Electric single-dose grinder with 78 mm flat burrs and a stepless dial.

notes.turkish: Honest Coffee Guide lists no Turkish range.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): espresso 0–2.6, moka pot 2.3–7.6, AeroPress 1.6–13, V60 3–8.3, filter coffee machine 1.2–11.9, French press 8.2–18, cold brew 10.2–18; Turkish N/A. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion. For the stock burrs.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
